sample_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true
sample_count_total.description: Total active sample batches logged in the operational database

individual_sample_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_details sd INNER JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON sh.id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true

sample_count_pending_review.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND status IN ('Technical Verification', 'Sample Receipt & Preparation', 'Sample Request & Submission') GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC
sample_count_pending_review.description: Sample batches awaiting review, verification, or preparation

sample_count_request_review.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND status = 'Samples Request Review'
sample_count_request_review.description: Sample batches currently in request review

sample_count_approved.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND status = 'Sample Approval'

sample_count_verified.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND status = 'Sample Verification'

sample_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers sh WHERE sh.isactive = true AND sh.status = 'Samples In Lab'
sample_count_in_lab.description: Sample batches currently in the lab

batch_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers sh WHERE sh.isactive = true AND sh.status IN ('Analysis in Progress', 'Technical Verification', 'Sample Receipt & Preparation')
batch_count_in_lab.description: Sample batches currently in the lab

samples_by_status.sql: SELECT sh.status, COUNT(sd.id) as cnt FROM public.sample_details sd INNER JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON sh.id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true GROUP BY sh.status ORDER BY cnt DESC
samples_by_status.description: Distribution of individual samples by batch status

batch_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true

sample_count_today.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE

sample_count_this_week.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)

sample_count_this_month.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

samples_rejected.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('rejected', 'cancelled', 'sample rejected')

latest_received_batches.sql: SELECT batch_code, status, created_at::date as received_date FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

daily_ingestion_trend.sql: SELECT created_at::date as day, COUNT(*) as batches FROM public.sample_headers WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days') AND isactive = true GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC
daily_ingestion_trend.description: Batch registration volume per day for the last 14 days

sample_type_distribution.sql: SELECT sample_type_id::text as sample_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true GROUP BY sample_type_id ORDER BY count DESC
sample_type_distribution.description: Sample volume by sample type id

inventory_low_stock.sql: SELECT batch_code, status, stock_in, stock_out, (stock_in - stock_out) as balance FROM public.inventory_items WHERE (stock_in - stock_out) <= 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
inventory_low_stock.description: Inventory items with zero or negative calculated balance

inventory_order_status.sql: SELECT po_number, status as fulfillment_status, supplier_id::text as supplier, created_at FROM public.inventory_items WHERE po_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

supplier_order_performance.sql: SELECT supplier_id::text as supplier, COUNT(*) as total_items, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in_inventory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_inventory FROM public.inventory_items WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT 10
supplier_order_performance.description: Inventory receipts grouped by supplier id

inventory_stock_by_category.sql: SELECT inventory_category_id::text as category, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(stock_in - stock_out) as balance FROM public.inventory_items GROUP BY inventory_category_id ORDER BY balance ASC LIMIT 20

inventory_expiring_soon.sql: SELECT batch_code, expiry, (stock_in - stock_out) as balance FROM public.inventory_items WHERE expiry BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY expiry ASC LIMIT 15
inventory_expiring_soon.description: Inventory batches expiring in the next 30 days

equipment_utilization.sql: SELECT name, equipment_number, status, active FROM public.equipment ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
equipment_utilization.description: Recent equipment records from the operational database

equipment_maintenance_schedule.sql: SELECT name, equipment_number, (date_purchased + (maintainance_days || ' days')::interval)::date as next_maintenance_due, assigned_department FROM public.equipment WHERE active = true ORDER BY next_maintenance_due ASC LIMIT 10
equipment_maintenance_schedule.description: Upcoming equipment maintenance dates calculated from purchase date and maintenance interval

equipment_downtime_summary.sql: SELECT name, equipment_number, status, condition FROM public.equipment WHERE active = false OR LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('down', 'inactive', 'broken', 'out of service') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
equipment_downtime_summary.description: Equipment records that appear inactive or unavailable

equipment_count_active.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.equipment WHERE active = true

equipment_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.equipment

equipment_count_inactive.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.equipment WHERE active = false

equipment_maintenance_health.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM public.equipment GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC

equipment_verification_status.sql: SELECT name, equipment_number, verificaction_days, verification_notification_in_days, updated_at::date as last_updated FROM public.equipment WHERE active = true ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 15
equipment_verification_status.description: Equipment verification configuration and last update date

qc_pass_rate.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(status_code, '')) IN ('pass', 'passed', 'approved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passing FROM public.qc_results
qc_pass_rate.description: QC result totals and passing count

qc_drifting_analytes.sql: SELECT analyte_id::text as analyte, robust_cv_percentage FROM public.qc_processed_result WHERE robust_cv_percentage > 15 ORDER BY robust_cv_percentage DESC LIMIT 10
qc_drifting_analytes.description: QC analytes with robust CV above warning threshold

capa_pending.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.corrective_actions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND LOWER(COALESCE(status_name, '')) NOT IN ('closed', 'completed', 'cancelled')

samples_pending_qc.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND is_qc_batch = true AND LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) NOT IN ('completed', 'approved')
samples_pending_qc.description: QC sample batches not completed or approved

complaints_trend.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date as month, COUNT(*) as complaints FROM public.complaints WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC

audit_findings_open.description: Open audit findings placeholder until direct operational audit table mapping is confirmed

qc_stability_report.sql: SELECT analyte_name, robust_cv_pct, pass_rate_pct, total_tests FROM public.v_qc_stability_metrics ORDER BY robust_cv_pct DESC LIMIT 10
qc_stability_report.description: Top 10 analytes by variability (CV%) and their pass rates

qc_out_of_control_events.sql: SELECT analyte_name, test_date, avg_value, center_line, control_status FROM public.v_qc_drift_trends WHERE control_status = 'OUT_OF_CONTROL' ORDER BY test_date DESC LIMIT 15
qc_out_of_control_events.description: Recent QC results that triggered Out-of-Control alerts

tat_overall_average.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(tat_overdue_days * 24.0), 1) as avg_tat_hours FROM public.tat_captured WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND is_complete = true
tat_overall_average.description: Average overdue TAT hours for completed records in the last 30 days

tat_overdue_batches.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sample_header_id) as overdue_batches FROM public.tat_captured WHERE tat_overdue_days > 0 AND is_complete = false AND created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
tat_overdue_batches.description: Batches with overdue unfinished TAT records in the last 30 days

tat_by_analyte.sql: SELECT analyte_id::text as analyte, ROUND(AVG(tat_overdue_days * 24.0), 1) as avg_hours, COUNT(*) as test_count FROM public.tat_captured WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') GROUP BY analyte_id ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 10
tat_by_analyte.description: Average TAT overdue hours by analyte id

tat_sla_compliance.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tat_overdue_days <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as sla_pct FROM public.tat_captured WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND is_complete = true
tat_sla_compliance.description: Completed TAT records within SLA over the last 30 days

lab_tat_stage_summary.sql: SELECT workflow_stage, total_batches, overdue_batches, due_today_batches, ROUND(avg_days_to_target::numeric, 1) as avg_days_to_target FROM public.v_lab_tat_stage_summary ORDER BY total_batches DESC
lab_tat_stage_summary.description: Summary of batches per workflow stage with overdue/due-today counts

lab_tat_aging_report.description: Distribution of active batches by their aging/overdue status

complaint_count_open.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM public.complaints WHERE is_closed = false

ticket_backlog_priority.sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM public.complaints WHERE is_closed = false GROUP BY priority ORDER BY cnt DESC

ticket_resolution_time.sql: SELECT priority, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_time - created_at)) / 3600), 1) as avg_resolution_hours FROM public.complaints WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY priority ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours DESC
ticket_resolution_time.description: Average complaint resolution hours by priority

tickets_by_department.sql: SELECT current_department, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_closed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_count FROM public.complaints WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY current_department ORDER BY open_count DESC LIMIT 10

sla_compliance.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN resolution_sla_status = 'Achieved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as sla_pct FROM public.complaints WHERE created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')

analyst_verifications.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(sh.id) as batches_verified FROM public.users u JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON u.id = sh.verify_user_id WHERE sh.created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND u.active = 1 GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_verified DESC LIMIT 15
analyst_verifications.description: Batches verified by analyst in the last 30 days

analyst_approvals.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(sh.id) as batches_approved FROM public.users u JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON u.id = sh.approve_user_id WHERE sh.created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND u.active = 1 GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_approved DESC LIMIT 15
analyst_approvals.description: Batches approved by analyst in the last 30 days

analyst_workload_today.sql: SELECT u.name as analyst, COUNT(sh.id) as batches_touched FROM public.users u JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON u.id IN (sh.verify_user_id, sh.approve_user_id) WHERE sh.updated_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND u.active = 1 GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_touched DESC LIMIT 15

top_clients_by_volume.sql: SELECT c.name as client, COUNT(sh.id) as sample_batches FROM public.crm_customers c JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON c.id = sh.crm_customer_id WHERE sh.created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') AND sh.isactive = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sample_batches DESC LIMIT 10
top_clients_by_volume.description: Top customers by sample batch volume in the last 90 days

inactive_clients.sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(sh.created_at)::date as last_submission FROM public.crm_customers c LEFT JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON c.id = sh.crm_customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING MAX(sh.created_at) < (NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days') OR MAX(sh.created_at) IS NULL ORDER BY last_submission ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 25
inactive_clients.description: Customers with no sample submissions in the last 60 days

client_submission_today.sql: SELECT c.name as client, COUNT(sh.id) as batches_today FROM public.crm_customers c JOIN public.sample_headers sh ON c.id = sh.crm_customer_id WHERE sh.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND sh.isactive = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY batches_today DESC LIMIT 15
